thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT [SEV2] 1769543210 — elevated 503 rate observed on inference-gateway:/v1/generate (15% errors over 3m). Paging @sam, @noah. Logs: request spikes from tenant nuvo-docs.

sam: I’m on it. Acknowledged.

sam: quick triage — looks like a sharp increase in sequence length for a small subset of requests causing KV cache misses + OOM-ish behaviour on the gateway path.

sam: pulling gateway logs and recent traces now. running `rg "nuvo-docs" /var/log/gateway/* | tail -n 200`

sam: snippet from proxy logs:
```
2026-02-21T08:12:34Z INF request id=abc123 tenant=nuvo-docs path=/v1/generate seq_len=8192 tokens=6000 mem=78% -> backend-error 503
2026-02-21T08:12:36Z INF request id=abc124 tenant=nuvo-docs path=/v1/generate seq_len=9216 tokens=7200 mem=92% -> delayed
```

maria: CS ping — Maria here. Which customers impacted? Nuvo-docs is in pilot, they just messaged support.

sam: Confirmed impact: Nuvo-docs and a handful of internal test agents. Impact window ~08:12–08:28 UTC. Estimated % of total traffic ~0.6% but they had repeated retries -> amplified errors for them.

noah: On it — manual scale and routing changes. Autoscaler seems stuck; I'll spin up nodes.

noah: running `rictl pool scale inference-pool --replicas 6 --timeout 5m`

ops-bot: Requested scale accepted, new instances scheduled.

sam: Immediate mitigation: enable routing fallback for tenants with repeated 503s to use a smaller model variant. This reduces memory/KV pressure.

sam: applying temporary policy:
```
PATCH /routing/policies/active
{"selector":{"tenant":"nuvo-docs"},"action":{"route_to":"redwood/gpt-small-opt"}}
```

elaine: +1 to fallback. Also add client-side retry-burden protection — we should ask SDK team to surface retry-after headers for 503s so clients back off.

jordan: Product note — reaching out to Nuvo-docs PM + CS. We should offer a short explanation and ETA. @maria can you coordinate? Also postmortem + remediation plan once stable.

maria: On it. I messaged them: "We're seeing transient errors, we've routed you to a safe fallback while we stabilize. We'll share a postmortem with timelines and action items." They replied they can tolerate reduced throughput for now.

ops-bot: Scale complete. Error rate dropping to 1.9% over last 2m. Traffic ramp looks stable.

sam: Good. Keeping in incident mode for 45m — will reassess then and start handoff notes.

sam: quick checklist for follow-up (will formalize into ticket):
- capture trace ids and sample requests (owner: sam)
- autoscaler root cause + fix (owner: noah)
- routing fallback automation + policy tests (owner: elaine)
- SDK retry guidance / retry-after header (owner: jordan & devex)

noah: preliminary find — autoscaler decision loop starved due to high CPU on controller pod; need to investigate metrics and single-threaded loop behaviour.

elaine: suggest we add a canary that simulates extreme seq_len to the staging suite so we catch this during deploys.

jordan: I'll open a postmortem ticket and a follow-up learning session. Proposed: 1) Postmortem doc + action items in JIRA, 2) 45m brown-bag training for eng-sre + devex on fallback patterns.

sam: sounds good. Proposed schedule: postmortem doc by EOD today; brown-bag next Mon 11am PST. Can everyone confirm availability?

maria: I can do Mon 11am. I'll also prepare a short customer-facing note template.

noah: ack for postmortem ticket, will own autoscaler debugging task.

elaine: ack — will add canary item and write tests for routing fallback.

jordan: created ticket RI-5378 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-5378 — Postmortem: SEV2 gateway 503 spike — includes action items and owners. Please add notes.

sam: adding immediate action: update runbook runbooks/inference-gateway.md with a step to apply fallback routing and scale commands. Will add a minimal command block.

sam: runbook snippet to include:
```
# fallback route
rictl route set --tenant=nuvo-docs --model=redwood/gpt-small-opt
# scale pool
rictl pool scale inference-pool --replicas=6
```

elaine: +:thumbsup: Good. Also flag we should revisit KV cache TTL heuristics — observed that cold-cache heavy sequences cause eviction storms.

ops-bot: Incident auto-note: incident closed to paging at 1769544810. Post-incident tracking remains open under RI-5378.

sam: wrapping up thread: mitigation worked, customer routed to fallback, autoscaler scale helped. We'll keep postmortem actions tracked in RI-5378. Brown-bag confirmed Mon 11am PST.

jordan: I'll schedule the brown-bag and add agenda: root cause, prevention patterns (canary + cache tuning), routing/fallback runbook walkthrough, customer comms checklist.

maria: I'll prepare the customer-facing timeline and share before the brown-bag.

sam: thanks all. I'll hand this over to elaine/noah for the deep fix and to jordan for comms. Closing live paging thread.
